title: Bufalin post-transcriptionally suppresses STAT3 to alleviate renal ferroptosis and tubulointerstitial fibrosis in diabetic kidney disease.
authors: Qiao, Yunyang; Gao, Chen; Ji, Jialing; Li, Zuolin; Shi, Huimin; Yan, Ruilian; Sun, Jiayue; Wang, Yueyi; Lin, Qiang; Zhang, Aiqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟾毒灵通过转录后调控STAT3抑制肾小管上皮细胞铁死亡和纤维化，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度不足。
abstract: The pathological hallmark of diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is tubulointerstitial fibrosis (TIF), which arises from extracellular matrix (ECM) synthesis in renal tubular epithelial cells (RTECs). Bufalin has the potential in delaying the progression of kidney disease, and ferroptosis plays a critical role in this regulatory process. In this study, we investigated the effects of bufalin on DKD models by analyzing the expression of TIF and ferroptosis-related markers and evaluating the impact of ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1) on TIF. Our findings revealed that the treatment of bufalin in db/db mice and high glucose (HG)-induced RTECs altered the expression of TIF-related indicators. Ferroptosis was activated during the progression of TIF. Characteristic changes in ferroptosis, including iron overload, increased production of lipid peroxidation products, and decreased mitochondrial cristae, are induced by HG, and the treatment of Fer-1 reversed ferroptosis and further mitigated TIF. Notably, the intervention of bufalin in DKD models exhibited an inhibitory effect on ferroptosis. Network pharmacology analysis identified signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) as a target of bufalin, and knockdown of STAT3 altered the expression of ferroptosis and TIF-related indicators. Molecular docking studies, dual-luciferase reporter assay, and mRNA stability analysis further elucidated the regulation of STAT3 by bufalin and regulatory mechanism. Overall, these results demonstrate that bufalin promotes the degradation of STAT3 mRNA via a post-transcriptional mechanism. This downregulation inhibits STAT3-mediated ferroptosis, ultimately alleviating TIF in DKD.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）的病理标志是肾小管间质纤维化（TIF），其源于肾小管上皮细胞（RTECs）中的细胞外基质（ECM）合成。蟾毒灵具有延缓肾脏疾病进展的潜力，而铁死亡（ferroptosis）在此调控过程中发挥关键作用。在本研究中，我们通过分析TIF和铁死亡相关标志物的表达，并评估ferrostatin-1（Fer-1）对TIF的影响，探讨了蟾毒灵对DKD模型的作用。我们的研究结果显示，在db/db小鼠和高糖（HG）诱导的RTECs中，蟾毒灵处理改变了TIF相关指标的表达。铁死亡在TIF进展过程中被激活。HG诱导了铁死亡的特征性变化，包括铁过载、脂质过氧化产物生成增加以及线粒体嵴减少，而Fer-1处理逆转了铁死亡并进一步缓解了TIF。值得注意的是，蟾毒灵在DKD模型中的干预表现出对铁死亡的抑制作用。网络药理学分析确定信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）为蟾毒灵的靶点，且STAT3的敲低改变了铁死亡和TIF相关指标的表达。分子对接研究、双荧光素酶报告基因实验和mRNA稳定性分析进一步阐明了蟾毒灵对STAT3的调控及其机制。总体而言，这些结果表明，蟾毒灵通过转录后机制促进STAT3 mRNA的降解。这种下调抑制了STAT3介导的铁死亡，最终缓解了DKD中的TIF。
